info.title: Payroll Management API
info.description: REST API for the NexziByte Payroll Management application. All endpoints except /auth/login, sign-up, /health and /ready require the session cookie, and permissions are enforced on every request. The attendance application sends data to /integrations/attendance with an API key (Authorization: Bearer) instead of a session.

Body: `{ batchId?, year, month, records: [{ employeeCode, values: { <field>: number|string } }] }`. A `batchId` is accepted once per key; repeating it returns the original result. Fields are mapped to monthly input columns in Attendance sync settings.
